strategy: Problem intent -> trusted Brali protocol -> Query/Agent Skill/API reuse -> canonical citation.

activation_gate.external_distribution: At least one provider-visible external distribution artifact must be live and recorded before expanding these candidates into a large new page set.
activation_gate.search_demand: Prefer clusters with observed search impressions, clicks, queries, backlinks, or integration demand. Do not infer demand from inventory size.
activation_gate.content_rule: Strengthen existing canonical problem/topic/protocol surfaces first. Do not generate thin keyword permutations.
